description: Liquid AI's LFM3-Audio-2B, from the llama.cpp-format GGUFs Liquid publishes or the upstream safetensors directory. ASR: a log-mel LFM2 encoder feeds an LFM3 hybrid conv/attention backbone. TTS: the backbone drives a bidirectional MaskGIT depth decoder (12 codebooks, 12.5 Hz) and the LiquidCodec decoder and ISTFT give 24 kHz audio. S2S: a spoken question in, interleaved text and audio out, with client-held multi-turn history.

request.name: language
request.description: ASR: ISO code of the spoken language (prompt 'Perform ASR in <English name>.'); auto lets the model infer it ('Perform ASR.'). TTS: picks the default voice of that language when no voice is given.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: ASR: text tokens per audio chunk (max(512, 8 per second of audio); chat 512, or 2048 with enable_thinking). TTS: audio frames (80 ms) per text chunk (512). S2S: text tokens and frames of the reply together (1024).

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: ASR: longest chunk in seconds; auto keeps input up to this long whole and splits longer input at VAD pauses.

request.name: max_audio_tail_frames
request.description: S2S: most audio frames after the reply text ends before the turn is closed with an end-of-audio frame; 0 disables the cap.

request.name: temperature
request.description: TTS and S2S: audio code temperature; 0 picks the most likely code. The default is the checkpoint's generation_config.json audio_temperature.

request.name: top_k
request.description: TTS and S2S: sample audio codes from the k most likely; 0 keeps all. The default is the checkpoint's audio_top_k.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: TTS and S2S: audio repetition penalty over the last 4096 frames (the checkpoint's audio_repetition_window) of each codebook; must be positive, 1 disables it. The default is the checkpoint's audio_repetition_penalty.

request.name: text_temperature
request.description: ASR and S2S: text token temperature; 0 is greedy.

request.name: text_top_k
request.description: ASR and S2S: sample text tokens from the k most likely; 0 keeps all.

request.name: seed
request.description: Sampling seed (random when absent); TTS text chunk i uses seed + i.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: TTS long-form text chunking (values as text::parse_text_chunk_mode_override accepts).

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: TTS: target characters per text chunk.

request.name: stream_frames_per_event
request.description: TTS and S2S streaming: audio frames per event.

request.name: return_codes
request.description: S2S: return the lfm3_audio.reply artifact a client sends back with the next turn.

request.name: chat
request.description: ASR task: answer the spoken input as a text chat reply instead of transcribing it.

request.name: enable_thinking
request.description: ASR chat: let the model think first; only the text after </think> is returned.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Weight storage at load. native keeps the file's types (BF16 falls back to F16 where the backend lacks BF16). f32 also uses F32 KV caches and explicit attention, for parity checks.

session.name: cpu_repack
session.description: CPU: repack matmul weights for ggml's extra buffer kernels.

session.name: vad_model_path
session.description: VAD model (any built-in VAD family; default Silero VAD) used by ASR audio_chunk_mode auto/vad.

session.name: max_pass_duration_sec
session.description: Most audio, in seconds, the encoder takes in one pass (an ASR chunk or the S2S question); longer audio is rejected before it is encoded.

ui.summary: LFM3-Audio transcription, multilingual speech and spoken chat from Liquid's published GGUFs.
